releaseNotes: Overhauled MR Tour Plan request & submission UI with spacious, card-based visit views and zero crushed rows
Unified single-action Tour Plan approvals: approving a plan immediately marks all visits Approved and reconciles tasks without duplicate review
Accurate destination capture: automatically defaults to selected route terminal stops and HQ territories
Prominent batch locations display: all planned doctors and clinics for each route circuit are clearly visible in green chips
Eliminated phantom whitespace layout glitches caused by nested modals inside mobile scrollviews
